raw.body: Hey, I independently reproduced this on current `main` and I can confirm too. **Setup:** `renderToPipeableStream` + `onHeaders`, rendering an `` with `fetchPriority="high" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"`. **Actual `Link` header:** ``` ; rel=preload; as="image"; fetchpriority="high" ``` **Expected:** ``` ; rel=preload; as="image"; fetchpriority="high"; referrerpolicy="no-referrer" ``` `referrerpolicy` is silently dropped — no warning at all, just a wrong header. The DOM `` fallback path works correctly; the bug is specific to the HTTP header path. **Root cause:** one-character typo in [`ReactFizzConfigDOM.js` L3407](https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/main/packages/react-dom-bindings/src/server/ReactFizzConfigDOM.js#L3407): ```js // header path (buggy) — props.refererPolicy is always undefined referrerPolicy: props.refererPolicy, // DOM fallback path (correct, L3444) referrerPolicy: props.referrerPolicy, ``` Because `props.refererPolicy` is `undefined`, `getPreloadAsHeader` skips it silently. PR #36561 has the right fix. +1 from me.
